docker rm -f ollama
docker rmi ollama/ollama:rocm
docker run --name ollama \\
  -v /home/ato/ollama:/root/.ollama \\
  -e OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=true \\
  -e HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION="11.0.0" \\
  -e OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE="q8_0" \\
  -e OLLAMA_DEBUG=0 \\
  --device /dev/kfd \\
  --device /dev/dri \\
  -p 127.0.0.1:11434:11434 -d \\
  ollama/ollama:rocm \\
  serve

docker exec ollama ollama run ornith:9b

#!/bin/bash

set -o nounset
set -o errexit
set -o pipefail

git fetch --prune
git branch -vv | grep 'gone]' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs git branch -D
